exposure: Vaginal delivery of first twin followed by emergency cesarean delivery of the second twin (cases) vs. vaginal delivery of both twins (controls)
outcome: Cesarean delivery of the second twin
cohort: Twin pregnancies delivered at a tertiary center in Toulouse, France, between 2004 and 2018, excluding deliveries before 24 weeks of gestation, birth weight below 500 grams, fetal death in utero, terminations of pregnancy, and delayed delivery.
finding: Maternal overweight, weight gain during pregnancy, and preterm labor were associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery of the second twin after vaginal delivery of the first twin.
